title: Horizontal force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the horizontal force as F = (4/3)mg or equivalent.

title: Maximum height value
description: Essential: Correctly states the maximum height from OP as (4/3)H or equivalent.

title: Horizontal distance OP
description: Essential: Correctly states the distance OP as (32/9)H or equivalent.

title: Force analysis at N
description: Important: Applies force equilibrium or kinematics to relate horizontal force, gravity, and the 37° angle at point N/P.

title: Vertical motion symmetry
description: Important: Recognizes symmetry in vertical velocity between ascent to Q and descent from Q to N, or correctly uses time/velocity relations for segments M-N and N-Q.

title: Horizontal kinematics segments
description: Important: Correctly analyzes horizontal motion in three distinct segments (O-M, M-N, N-P) with appropriate acceleration/velocity relations.

title: Vertical displacement relation
description: Important: Establishes the relationship between vertical displacements H (M-N) and h (N-Q), e.g., h = H/3.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies sign for acceleration or velocity in vertical/horizontal components, or confuses the direction of the net force.

title: Trigonometric error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses sine/cosine for the 37° angle when relating velocity components or forces (e.g., tan 37° = opposite/adjacent).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Explicitly checks dimensional consistency of derived expressions for force, height, and distance.
